scope: Retain the Issue 30 validation decision boundary without launching a physical reactive-film campaign.

case_classes.required_evidence: Packet-bound equilibrium liquid and gas-film zero-fugacity-drive closure with zero signed CO2 flux.
case_classes.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; the zero-drive calculation cannot be evaluated without an admitted packet-bound state.

case_classes.required_evidence: Admitted film inputs and analytic two-film signed-flux comparison with finite reaction sources disabled.
case_classes.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; the no-reaction comparison cannot be evaluated.

case_classes.required_evidence: Retained linear fugacity-composition reference compared with complete signed flux.
case_classes.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; the linear-limit comparison cannot be evaluated.

case_classes.required_evidence: Admitted reverse-driving state with physically correct negative CO2 transfer direction.
case_classes.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; no reverse-driving physical state may be invented.

case_classes.required_evidence: Source rate states used by the accepted kinetics and transport leaves.
case_classes.non_execution_reason: The accepted Issue 36 result has no admitted concentration, kinetic, or transport intersection for a film-rate evaluation.

case_classes.required_evidence: At least one independent rate observation in each available lean, middle, and rich admitted class, compared on its source area and driving-force basis.
case_classes.non_execution_reason: Zero admitted Issue 36 film-input states means no independent observed-versus-calculated film rate can be compared.

case_classes.required_evidence: All 21 retained Case 3C axial stress states that lie inside the admitted temperature, concentration, and loading domain.
case_classes.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; the 21-state application stress set cannot be launched.

reproduction.timeout_meaning: No physical case is launched, so no timeout is assigned. A future timeout is incomplete numerical evidence, not physical disagreement.
reproduction.source_revision_protocol: Run from a clean source commit containing the Issue 30 input and resolver but none of the generated Issue 30 outputs; commit the source stage first and the generated result stage separately.

claim_boundary: The retained result supports only the Issue 30 supported-negative no-run decision. It does not validate limiting behavior, desorption, numerical convergence, initialization, rate observations, film flux, packed-column capture, or a model disagreement.
limitations: Issue 36 is accepted as a supported-negative packet-bound release result with zero admitted states and no version-2 input, schema, or receipt files.
Issue 19 remains open and has no investigator-approved timing campaign budget; no physical BVP campaign is authorized.
No timeout or failed state is retained as a physical disagreement because no physical state was launched.
The result blocks column replacement and downstream Issue 31 execution until an independent, source-admitted film validation result exists.
